736:t_1:86.en:
$$トロワ$$
「If no one does, we'll do it ourselves.」

736:t_1:87.en:
$$五飛$$
「I dedicated my life to laying the foundation for peace long ago.」

736:t_1:88.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Yeah! That's a soldier's duty too!」

736:t_1:89.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「It is our role to fight the enemies who threaten peace.」

736:t_1:90.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(My late friend $$グラハム・エーカー$$ would surely have said the same.)

736:t_1:91.en:
$$ノイン$$
「And $$リリーナ$$ and the others will protect the peace we win.」

736:t_1:92.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「For that, we must triumph over the $$御使い$$s and the universe's great collapse.」

736:t_1:94.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ヒイロ$$... What will you do when the fighting ends?」

736:t_1:97.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What do you plan to do?」

736:t_1:98.en:
$$刹那$$
「If we can make it through this battle...」

736:t_1:99.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm thinking of visiting the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ homeworld.」

736:t_1:100.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What are you going there for?」

736:t_1:101.en:
$$刹那$$
「I want to reaffirm what we gained in this battle... the ability to understand each other. I'll start with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

736:t_1:102.en:
$$刹那$$
「And if we truly grasped the truth of the universe, I want to use it to create something new.」

736:t_1:103.en:
$$刹那$$
「Even if it takes years... or decades.」

736:t_1:104.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「All right. ...But make sure you come back.」

736:t_1:105.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I want to know what new thing you create too.」

736:t_1:108.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Were you thinking about $$ミネバ$$?」

736:t_1:109.en:
$$バナージ$$
「To me, she's $$オードリー$$.」

736:t_1:110.en:
$$バナージ$$
「And to keep my promise to her, I will seize a future and return to Earth.」

736:t_1:112.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I change what needs to change... and keep what doesn't... I think that's fine.」

736:t_1:113.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Yes. I think that is your strength.」

736:t_1:115.en:
$$リディ$$
「Were you thinking about $$ミネバ$$?」

736:t_1:116.en:
$$バナージ$$
「To me, she's $$オードリー$$.」

736:t_1:117.en:
$$バナージ$$
「And to keep my promise to her, I will seize a future and return to Earth.」

736:t_1:119.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I change what needs to change... and keep what doesn't... I think that's fine.」

736:t_1:120.en:
$$バナージ$$
(That's right, isn't it, $$マリーダ$$...?)

736:t_1:121.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That $$バナージ$$... Does he understand this battle will decide the fate of every parallel world...?」

736:t_1:122.en:
$$クェス$$
「Are you jealous of $$バナージ$$ for having someone waiting for him, $$ギュネイ$$?」

736:t_1:123.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'd rather have $$クェス$$ fighting alongside me.」

736:t_1:124.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「...Then you really can't criticize $$バナージ$$, can you...?」

736:t_1:125.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Don't say that, $$ハサウェイ$$.」

736:t_1:126.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「A lover, family, anything will do. Having something to protect makes a man stronger.」

736:t_1:127.en:
$$クェス$$
「It's the same for women too. Right... Lieutenant $$エマ$$?」

736:t_1:128.en:
$$エマ$$
「Yes. We have to do our best for the people waiting on Earth too.」

736:t_1:129.en:
$$クェス$$
「$$バナージ$$ has it nice... He's got someone waiting for him.」

736:t_1:130.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Am I not good enough, $$クェス$$?」

736:t_1:133.en:
$$クェス$$
「I just thought it's nice to have someone waiting, but it's nice to have someone by your side like this too.」

736:t_1:135.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Getting a woman to say that much means you've become a man, $$ハサウェイ$$.」

736:t_1:136.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Having something to protect makes a man stronger.」

736:t_1:137.en:
$$クェス$$
「It's the same for women too. Right... Lieutenant $$エマ$$?」

736:t_1:138.en:
$$エマ$$
「Yes. We have to do our best for the people waiting on Earth too.」

736:t_1:139.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...Everyone seems less nervous than I expected.」

736:t_1:140.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We've come this far. All we can do now is fight. It's better to think about victory and fire ourselves up than fear defeat.」

736:t_1:141.en:
$$シャア$$
「This battle puts the future of humanity... of every parallel world at stake...」

736:t_1:142.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It seems you have something on your mind?」

736:t_1:143.en:
$$シャア$$
「If we survive this battle, will we grasp the truth and attain $$シンカ$$...?」

736:t_1:144.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「And become what they call higher-dimensional life-forms...?」

736:t_1:147.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The path to evolution may have opened, but that doesn't mean people will change in a single leap.」

736:t_1:148.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It will surely take a long time yet... As long as it took us to evolve from ape-men into humans...」

736:t_1:149.en:
$$シャア$$
「It seems we will not live to see where humanity is headed.」

736:t_1:150.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I do feel we are standing at its entrance. That is enough.」

736:t_1:151.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All we can do now is live believing there is something beyond it, and overcome anyone who stands in the way.」

736:t_1:152.en:
$$シャア$$
「I will risk my life for that, alongside those I trust.」

736:t_1:154.en:
$$シャア$$
「I told you, $$ハマーン$$. I will not leave you behind again.」

736:t_1:156.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Trust... Surely that will give us strength... the strength to open a future...)

736:t_1:157.en:
$$アムロ$$
(There is light beyond it... Isn't that right, $$ララァ$$...?)

736:t_1:160.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If every person could do that, conflict would disappear from this world.」

736:t_1:161.en:
$$カレン$$
「They can, $$ゼロ$$. After all, that's how we've fought all this time.」

736:t_1:162.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「But it will take a considerable time for all humanity to master the truth.」

736:t_1:163.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「And in the meantime, all sorts of rotten people will surely appear.」

736:t_1:164.en:
$$マオ$$
「So our fight will go on, to deal with people like that.」

736:t_1:165.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'd be in trouble otherwise. If the world suddenly became perfectly peaceful, we'd be completely out of a job.」
